note: Cover images for taxonomy rows that are NOT model/part leaves — generation roots, generation waves, retail lines, brand rows and franchise rows. The 504 model/part leaves are covered separately by scripts/fetch-taxonomy-images.mjs and canonical-beys.json; this manifest is the branch-and-brand half that corpus cannot express, because a wave is not a model.

sources.corpus: A local read-only mirror of beyblade.fandom.com images at $BEY_CORPUS/linka/images/fandom/**. Resolved by FILENAME, so the hash-bucket directory layout is an implementation detail. Zero network calls — the bytes are already on disk.
sources.wiki: A live MediaWiki pageimages lookup against the named domain. Only used where no corpus file exists. 🛑 A domain goes in here ONLY after a real request has been shown to return a usable lead image for that subject — see the script header.

conventions.variant: "cover" fills display.coverImage. "hasbro" fills hasbroCoverImage, the logo shown beside the 'Also known as' name.
conventions.omission: A taxonomy row absent from this file keeps whatever it already has (a seedPhoto placeholder tile, or nothing). That is deliberate: an honest gap beats a wrong or guessed image, the same rule the 25-of-220 uncovered models already follow.

knownGaps.note: Subjects deliberately left uncovered, with the reason. Recorded so the next person does not re-derive the search — and so a gap reads as a decision rather than an oversight.
knownGaps.category-burst-bu: No Takara-Tomy 'Burst Ultimate' wordmark in the mirror. Beyblade_Burst_QuadStrike_Logo.png exists but is Hasbro's contemporaneous line, and no source we hold states the two are the same toyline renamed — so using it as this wave's cover would assert a correspondence nobody confirmed.
knownGaps.category-x-over: No X-Over Project wordmark in the mirror.
knownGaps.category-metal-phws: The 2008 Metal System debut has no logo distinct from the Metal Fight Beyblade series mark already used on the generation root; reusing it here would put the same image on parent and child.
knownGaps.category-original-plastic-gen: Same problem: the only candidate is BeybladeLogo.jpg, already the Original generation root's cover.
knownGaps.category-original-spin-gear: BB_dual_system_logo.png is the Dual System sub-mark, not the Spin Gear System. Close enough to be tempting and not the same thing.
knownGaps.category-original-hms: Heavy_Metal_Battle_Logo.jpg names a tournament, not the Heavy Metal System toyline.
knownGaps.non-beyblade: Every Trading Cards, Collectible Figures, Hot Wheels, Model Kits and Living Collectibles row, plus the ~19 non-Beyblade brand rows and 7 inactive franchise rows. The mirror is Beyblade-only, so these need either a verified per-subject wiki domain or the hand-curated official-logo manifest. None is guessed here.
